description: This file implements an Exchange 2016 calendar service class with methods for creating, updating, deleting events, and fetching calendar availability, using the ews-javascript-api library.

classes.name: ExchangeCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing calendar operations for Exchange 2016 using the ews-javascript-api, including event creation, update, deletion, and availability retrieval.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in Exchange with provided details.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event identified by UID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by UID.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves busy dates for selected calendars within a date range.

methods.name: getExchangeService
methods.description: Initializes and returns an ExchangeService instance configured with credentials and URL.
